development_data: 2026-10-12 Kyoto R7-R12 only; not prospective evidence

metadata_inputs.quality_tier_policy: append-only official tier mappings for newly encountered race names; existing baseline mappings may not change during v3.1 holdout

holdout_start_rule: The first eligible Kyoto race whose valid source capture, odds snapshot and pre-result freeze all satisfy the fixed 15-25 minute pre-post window after created_at_jst is holdout race 1. Every subsequent eligible Kyoto race is attempted in chronological order until 20 scored races are accumulated; do not backfill or skip an eligible race because another race that day was already counted.
change_control: Any threshold or rescue-logic change creates v3.2 or later and starts a new holdout window.
integrity_note: The frozen snapshot preparer records its Git blob SHA and source-page hashes. The frozen holdout wrapper verifies the preparer SHA, wrapper SHA, classifier SHA, baseline quality tiers, race ID, active horse-number set, Kyoto/flat/class/age eligibility, and that both odds observation and freeze occur 15-25 minutes before scheduled post.
